items.title: AbbVie lands FDA approval for next-generation Parkinson’s drug, Juvmo
items.summary: Juvmo was designed to offer a reduction in motor symptoms, while reducing non-motor side effects, through its more selective mechanism.

items.title: Oral solid dose at a turning point: Scaling for the next generation of therapies
items.summary: From patient-centric designs and sustainable changes to component shortages, anti-counterfeiting, and low-volume production, sponsors of OSD products are navigating a number of packaging trends and challenges.

items.title: Novo inks $1.33bn long-lasting injectable pact with Sweden-based Nanexa
items.summary: Novo has meanwhile been busy bolstering its pipeline amid a target to launch more than five multi-blockbusters by 2030.

items.title: Daiichi Sankyo, MSD withdraw cancer drug application
items.summary: Daiichi Sankyo and Merck & Co (MSD) have voluntarily withdrawn their biologics license application (BLA) for ifinatamab deruxtecan, aimed at treating adult patients with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer (ES-SCLC).

items.title: Mirum and Incyte’s Atebrioz approved for FOP in US
items.summary: The US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has approved Mirum Pharmaceuticals and Incyte’s Atebrioz (zilurgisertib) for the treatment of fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva (FOP) in patients aged 12 and above.
